title: Discharge sealing and oil-fume extraction in an atmosphere mesh-belt furnace
summary: Suneng's controlled-atmosphere roller-supported mesh-belt furnace proposal combines an oxygen probe and carbon-potential controller with oil-fume handling at the furnace exit. Carbon-potential measurement alone is insufficient for comparison. As workpieces drop from the protective-atmosphere heating zone into oil, the chute's oil-level seal, oil curtain and extraction also affect the proposed atmosphere-control conditions.
